note: Coverage matrix required by the brainstorm conclusion: measured / measured-but-confounded / planned / gap / not_applicable, with review state. `planned` points at the queue task that owns the work; `gap` means no committed measurement and none currently planned in a released task.

dimensions.evidence: studies/02-ticket-booking, studies/03-reserved-seating: per-node 2 CPU / 3 GiB database budget, 2 CPU / 2 GiB client, 8 connections, documented in every manifest; throttling reported per cell.
dimensions.limit: One host, eight shared cores, no real network; the 3-node cluster is a placement experiment, not a distributed-systems result.

dimensions.evidence: Study 01 D4/D5/D6 (rollup/embedding) and D3 (rolldown); Study 02 X1 ledger; Study 03 L2/L3 layouts; Study 05 ref-rollup-trigger / ref-embedded-locked.
dimensions.limit: The Study 01 D3 rolldown package confounds the copied key with its SQL/indexes; the Study 03 row-versus-document contrast is a family/package comparison.

dimensions.evidence: Study 04 c1_optimistic_version vs c2_pessimistic_lock under one hot key / 16 writers; Study 02 P3 CAS vs lock-based designs.
dimensions.review_state: reviewed (study04 independent review, 2026-09-22) - 1.76x is an upper bound, single trial
dimensions.limit: One key, one trial, PostgreSQL only; no low-contention sweep.

dimensions.evidence: Study 03 L3's tablet balance is unexplained; Study 01 D7/D24 and Study 04 y1/y2 are placement intent with no placement verification; Study 05's placement pair was never executed.
dimensions.review_state: open; named in the phase-3b and Study 04/05 reviews
dimensions.limit: Physical placement is undocumented to today's standard, not proven uncolocated. Containers on one laptop are not evidence of colocation.

dimensions.evidence: Study 04 n0_rows_unindexed vs n1_rows_indexed at small only; phase E (1/10/30/60/120/500 entries) not run.
dimensions.limit: At 3 600 rows the whole table is cached, so the index control could not test its own hypothesis.

dimensions.evidence: Study 04 cadence phase G not run; Study 05's 300 s TTL never crossed in a measured run (unit tests only).
dimensions.review_state: owned by the Study 04 and Study 05 v2 protocols
dimensions.limit: Closed-loop, sequential phases only; no burst or jittered arrival.

dimensions.evidence: Study 01 D3 has five fresh loads; every other cited run is one trial per measurement.
dimensions.review_state: open; required by both v2 protocols
dimensions.limit: Spreads within a measurement are not an across-trial error bar.

dimensions.evidence: Every cited run fixes a per-database-node budget; no cell charges the cache or the extra nodes to a shared total.
dimensions.review_state: open; named in the methodology minimums and both v2 protocols
dimensions.limit: Single-vs-cluster ratios answer 'add machines', not 'same total budget'.

dimensions.evidence: Studies 01, 02 and 03 include YugabyteDB 1-node and 3-node RF=3 cells; Study 04 is PostgreSQL only; Study 05 is PostgreSQL + Redis only.
dimensions.limit: Studies 04 and 05 have no YugabyteDB cell; this is a named gap, not a null result.

dimensions.evidence: All cited races and read phases are closed loop; the platform's arrival driver was not used.
dimensions.review_state: open; required by the Study 05 v2 protocol and the methodology minimums
dimensions.limit: Closed-loop tails are floors, not SLO figures.

dimensions.evidence: JSONB/state is not evidence for a native document database, and Redis was tested only as a cache; no native document, key-value, graph or wide-column database was measured.
dimensions.review_state: open; recorded as a new gap by this correction
dimensions.limit: Do not transfer the embedded-document or cache results to a native family.

dimensions.evidence: The '3-node' cluster shares one laptop with no real network; multi-node client access is not proven balanced across endpoints.
dimensions.review_state: open; recorded as a new gap by this correction
dimensions.limit: Placement and network results are not distributed-systems results.
